title: Role-specific visibility and edit capabilities
description: Map infrastructure capabilities onto the 5-tier RBAC
spec:
1. Define read-only, operator, manager, admin, and sysop access patterns using ROLE_HIERARCHY.
2. Enforce role checks on every backend route and frontend route.
3. Hide restricted notes, management URLs, and support contacts from low-privilege users.
4. Verify each role sees and edits only what it should via API and UI.
